caseName: White v. Regents of the Univ. of Cal.
caseNameFull: Timothy WHITE v. REGENTS OF the UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA

opinions.text: Motion of The American Association of Physical Anthropologists, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of The Ohio Archaeological Council, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied.
